posts.caption:
My number one piece of advice for anyone thinking of starting a business? Find a mentor (and actually lean on them).

When I was young, I had no trouble asking people for help. If someone had done something I was trying to do, I would pick up the phone and ask how they’d gone about it. I didn’t think of that as finding a mentor. I was curious, perhaps a little naive, and I knew there was a great deal I didn’t know.

Starting @VirginAtlantic brought that realisation to 30,000ft. I loved the idea of making flying better, but I had never run an airline. So, I reached out to someone who had - Sir

The brave may not live forever, but the cautious do not live at all. 
 
I wrote this in one of the first editions of Student magazine. They are words that have shaped my entire life.
 
Wonderful to see them plastered to the walls of @Virgin’s new office in New York - encouraging the team to make bold decisions and see where it takes them.

In my experience, the best businesses start by looking at an industry and asking: how could this be done better? 
 
This is our exact ambition with cross-Channel rail. Today, we shared a first glimpse of the bold black and red livery planned for our fleet of 12 @Alstom Avelia Stream trains. 
 
@Virgin's ambition is to run 20 daily return services between London and continental Europe from 2030. We want to bring more choice, some healthy competition, and more capacity to one of Europe’s most important travel routes. 
 
There is a huge opportunity here. More people are choosing rail for shorter
Our Mile High Tea has fans in high places ✈️

New York is always buzzing during Climate Week and the United Nations General Assembly. I come each year for the same reason: to have serious conversations that lead to meaningful change. 

Weeks like this aren’t about one person, one organisation or one big speech. They’re about showing up, listening, sharing knowledge and working together to turn ideas into action.

There are no easy answers to the challenges our world faces but spending time with so many brilliant, determined and hopeful people reminds me that progress is possible.

We all want to leave the world in a better place for our c
Hanging out with @CorneelKoster and some of the @VirginAtlantic team at HQ. Meeting our teams is one of my favourite things to do.

So touching to see @VirginAtlantic’s new plane paying tribute to my wonderful wife, Joan. 
 
Joan was part of the Virgin Atlantic story from the very beginning. From joining the inaugural flight in 1984, to coming up with the idea of donating loose change on-board for charity (which resulted in almost every airline in the world following suit and raising billions over the years). She was always there. 
 
Seeing the details of our family tartan, the heart-shaped necklace, and the rings she wore every day, brought back so many happy memories.

We get one go at this life. Don’t spend it wondering, “What if?”
 
The best things in my life began before I knew what I was doing.
 
Saying 'yes’ has changed my life. It’s opened up doors. It’s forged friendships. It’s taught lessons that will never leave me. 

Now, I’d love to hear about the wonderful yes moments that changed your life.

We’re officially searching for @Virgin’s next Head of Yes! The opportunity is open to everyone in the UK and US. You don’t need to have a huge following. You just need a real story about a time you threw caution to the wind.

One person will receive a deal w

One destination. Two extraordinary experiences 🏔️

From the heart of Verbier to 3,000 metres in the high Alps.

From ski-in living at @thelodgeverbier_ to the seclusion of @cabanetortin, where untouched snow, spectacular peaks and first tracks await.

One seamless Alpine journey, delivered exclusively by @VirginLimitedEdition.

Available throughout April 2027 for private groups up to 8–10 guests, with additional dates available on request, subject to availability.

The Lodge × Cabane Tortin

Recents from the camera roll…
1. Thinking back on my hot air ballooning days
2. Meeting the most wonderful students at a school we helped set up in Kenya. @MahaliMzuri
3. Flamingo love on @NeckerIsland 
4. The winner takes it all...
5. Alfie taking an afternoon nap

Did @RichardBranson just give @badassboz a new way to think about advertising? 👀

Watch episode 2 of Brilliant Conversations now on YouTube. Link in bio 📺

Did you know that @Virgin once imagined the iPod, but we made it into an April Fool’s joke!

In 1986, we announced the Virgin Music Box: a machine that could store music and let you call up any song you wanted. We thought it was so farfetched it would pass as a ‘gotcha’ moment. How wrong we were!

Years later, the world caught up with the idea, and I remember thinking: we should have built the bloody thing. The moral of the story is that when an idea feels slightly ridiculous, don’t dismiss it too quickly.

Sometimes the ridiculous ideas are a not-so-distant future...

Ryan Serhant is one of the most successful and well-known real estate brokers in the world. He is the founder and CEO of SERHANT., a multidimensional real estate brokerage that sits at the intersection of media, entertainment, education, and technology. He is also an innovator, entrepreneur, producer, best-selling author, podcast host, public speaker, educator, content creator, Executive Producer of Netflix's Owning Manhattan, star of multiple Bravo TV shows, including the two-time Emmy-nominated Million Dollar Listing New York.

Ryan has closed nearly $10B in sales and represented clients in record-breaking deals in New York and South Florida. Under Ryan’s leadership, SERHANT. has become one of the fastest-growing real estate firms in the United States, with agents across 8 states and an audience of over 6 million across social platforms. The company is also the home of LISTED, a dedicated YouTube network for entertaining lifestyle and real estate shows featuring the firm’s diverse up-and-coming real estate agents.

Ryan actively supports City Harvest, Feeding America, the Ali Forney Center, the NYC Sanitation Foundation, the American Cancer Society, and Project Sunshine.

Ryan currently resides in Brooklyn with his wife, Emilia, and their daughter, Zena.

linkedin.about:
Sahil Bloom is the New York Times Bestselling author of The 5 Types of Wealth: A Transformative Guide to Design Your Dream Life.

Sahil is an inspirational writer and entrepreneur, captivating millions of people every week through his book, social insights, and bi-weekly newsletter, The Curiosity Chronicle.

His debut non-fiction book, The 5 Types of Wealth, was an instant New York Times, USA Today, and Sunday Times Bestseller. Apple CEO Tim Cook called it "a powerful call to action to think deeply about what lights you up—and a guide for how to build a life of meaning and purpose around those things." The book is a unique blend of strategies, tactics, and actionable insights, enabling readers to make real, positive changes and lead healthier, wealthier lives. It has been translated into 39 languages and sold over 500,000+ copies worldwide.

Sahil is also an entrepreneur and owner of SRB Holdings, a personal holding company, and the Managing Partner of SRB Ventures, a $10 million venture investment firm committed to investing in and accelerating the most compelling startups in the world. Prior to launching SRB Ventures in January 2022, Sahil was an early-stage investor in 40+ startups across the technology landscape, including multiple unicorns.

Previously, Sahil spent seven years as a private equity investor and served on the board of several middle market companies during that period.

Sahil graduated from Stanford University with an M.A. in Public Policy (2014) and a B.A. in Economics & Sociology (2013). While at Stanford, he was a four-year member on the Stanford Baseball Team (2009-2013), twice helping to guide the team to NCAA Super Regional appearances (top-16 finishes). Additionally, Sahil earned two PAC-12 All-Academic Team awards and twice received the Bruce R. Cameron Memorial Award, given annually to a student-athlete exhibiting excellence in athletics, academics, and leadership. Academically, Sahil was advised in his pursuits by former Secretary of State Dr. Condoleezza Rice.

linkedin.about:
Simon Sinek is an unshakable optimist who believes in a bright future and our ability to build it together. Simon's WHY is to inspire people to do what inspires them so that, together, each of us can change our world for the better.

With a vision to change the way businesses think, act, and operate, Simon and his team work with leaders and organizations in nearly every industry to help transform company culture and create a better working world.

As a trained ethnographer, Simon has discovered remarkable patterns about how the greatest leaders and organizations think, act, and communicate. He is fascinated by the people and organizations that make the greatest, lasting impact on the world. He has devoted his life to sharing his thinking, and leading a movement to inspire people to do the things that inspire them.

Simon may be best known for popularizing the concept of WHY in his first Ted Talk in 2009. It has since become one of the most watched talks of all time on TED.com, with 37+ million views. 

Simon is a bestselling author and shares his ideas in the books Start With Why, Leaders Eat Last, Together Is Better, Find Your Why, and The Infinite Game.

Learn more at simonsinek.com.

positions.description: We imagine a world in which all people feel justice is administered with dignity, equity and fairness. The Curve is a 501(c)3 organization dedicated to making this vision a reality. Please visit thecurve.org to learn more.

During these times, we are all having to find new ways to connect. Join me every week as I talk with people that inspire me about love, life, leadership, and silver linings. The hope is that we all leave with something I think we need these days... A Bit of Optimism.

Listen online at https://simonsinek.com/podcast/ or wherever you get your podcasts.

We imagine a world where the vast majority of people wake up every day feeling inspired, feel safe at work, and fulfilled at the end of the day. My team and I believe in this bright future and our ability to build it together.

Get tools and resources to inspire at simonsinek.com.

Optimism Press is Simon’s publishing imprint with his longtime publisher, Penguin Random House. We have one mission: to publish the ideas that inspire us and give us the tools we need to build a more optimistic world.

We look to the business world, the nonprofit world, the military, politics, education, the clergy, and elsewhere to find authors who can both inspire us and offer us direction on how to build a world in which people feel inspired, safe, and fulfilled in their professional and personal lives. Optimism Press authors challenge our perspectives of how the world works, and offer new tools to help us on our own journey so that together we can build a brighter future. 

For more on the books published by Optimism Press, check out https://simonsinek.com/optimism-press/.

Simon is a spark that ignites passion and ideas. He envisions a world in which the vast majority of people wake up every single morning inspired, feel safe wherever they are, and end the day fulfilled by the work they do. As an unshakeable optimist, he believes in our ability to build this world together.

A trained ethnographer, Simon is fascinated by the people and organizations that make the greatest and longest-lasting impact. Over the years, he has discovered some remarkable patterns in how they think, act, and communicate, and also the environments in which people operate at their
natural best.

Simon may be best known for his TED Talk on the concept of WHY, which has been viewed over 60 million times, and his video on millennials in the workplace—which reached 80 million views in its rst week and has gone on to be seen hundreds of millions of times.

He continues to share inspiration through his bestselling books: 
- Start With Why: How Great Leaders Inspire Everyone to Take Action
- Leaders Eat Last: Why Some Teams Pull Together and Others Don’t
- Together Is Better: A Little Book of Inspiration
- Find Your Why: A Practical Guide to Discovering Purpose for You and Your Team
- The Infinite Game

Learn more at https://simonsinek.com/books/.

linkedin.about:
I'm the Founder & Managing Partner at Trust Fund, an early-stage venture fund backing software companies that help people and teams start, manage, and scale businesses. Our founders are killers building painkillers. 

Our LPs include Marc Andreessen, Jason Calacanis, David Sacks, Jeremy Liew, Andrew Chen, Chris Dixon, Jeff Jordan, Ev Williams, Paris Hilton, and Phil Hellmuth. 

Previously wrote an 18-week New York Times Bestseller, #GIRLBOSS, which was adapted into a scripted Netflix series that premiered on Netﬂix, produced by Charlize Theron. 

Started fashion e-tailer Nasty Gal at 22 years old and bootstrapped it to $30 million profitably, raised $60 million from Index Ventures and Thrive Capital, then scaled it to over $100 million in revenue. 

Went on the victory lap and was featured on the cover of Forbes magazine's 2016 America's Richest Self-Made Women issue (returned the dress I wore in the photo) and featured in the Fortune 40 under 40, Forbes 30 under 30, Inc. 30 under 30, and Fast Company’s Most Creative People in Business lists. 

My interests include drinking coffee on an empty stomach, choosing the best seats on commercial aircraft, and harvesting my hard-won experience for the next generation of founders.

positions.description:

linkedin.about:
Steven Bartlett is a 33-year-old British entrepreneur, investor in more than 100 companies, speaker, author, and media owner. He is the founder of Steven.com - the creator media company. Through it's podcast creator "label" called FlightStory, they create and scales new media podcast IP and commercialise that IP through brand partnerships, programmatic revenue, events, book publishing, newsletters, e-commerce, and new product development.

He is also the co-founder of thirdweb, a developer platform powering over 100,000 teams to build and launch web3 applications, and FlightCast, a video-first podcast hosting platform used by some of the world’s largest shows.

Steven first gained recognition as the co-founder and CEO of Social Chain AG, a social media marketing and e-commerce company he launched at 21 and took public on a European stock exchange by the age of 27 via reverse merger. Social Chain AG became a globally recognised business with hundreds of employees across London, Manchester, Berlin, New York, and Los Angeles, working with major brands including Amazon, Apple, and Coca-Cola.

Through his Fund and personal investments, he has backed companies including SpaceX, Huel, ZOE, Whoop, MrBeast, Groq, KetoneIQ, Cadence, PerfectTed, and over 60 others - focusing on businesses that improve human health, happiness, and performance.

Steven is also the creator and host of The Diary of a CEO, currently the world's most downloaded / watched podcast and the fastest-growing podcast in the world. He is the youngest-ever investor on BBC’s Dragons’ Den.

Podcast Enquiries: bookings@stevenbartlett.com
Events: events@stevenbartlett.com
Fund & Venture Investments: www.flightfund.com

positions.description: Steven.com is the creator economy company. We build and own businesses across every layer of it: media, technology, commerce, community and events. Home to some of the biggest creator IP and most advanced creator technology in the world. London, Manchester, New York and LA.

FlightStory is a creator media company and the home of The Diary of a CEO - With Steven Bartlett, We Need To Talk With Paul Brunson, Begin Again With Davina McCall, Hot Smart Rich With Maggie Sellers and 30 other creators. We produce long-form media IP that had reached billions globally.

A few years ago we got annoyed that all the podcast hosting platforms were inadequate and built for the past. So myself and Rox built a better one, which is built for the future. FlightCast is an AI-powered distribution platform built for podcast creators. It automates publishing, optimises content for each platform, and gives creators the infrastructure to grow without the operational overhead. www.flightcast.com. It's now used by many of the world's biggest shows.

8 years ago I met Leo Harrison before Chapter2 was founded, and we wanted to start a company together. We couldn't quite decide what to start, but ultimately he came back to me some years later with Chapter2 and I became the companies sole investor and partner. The company now employs hundreds of people and drives the talent function for some of the world's leading brands.
I started a podcast and it got out of hand.

PerfectTed is the UK’s fastest growing founder led company according to a recent report. They are also Europe’s leading Matcha brand. I was the first investor and partner, having invested £1m± into the company - they’ve recently exceeded $100m annual run rate and are on track to become the world’s biggest matcha brand. They are also Dragons Den's most successful ever deal.
Invested $2.8m into Neko Health to help build the infrastructure for preventable health care.

Empowering the next generation of creator-entrepreneurs. I joined Stan as an investor to help scale the most accessible platform for monetising digital audiences. From strategy to storytelling, I’m supporting Stan’s mission to make financial freedom possible for anyone with a smartphone and an idea.
Invested in SpaceX as a private company at a roughly $150b± valuation. SpaceX would later IPO reaching a $3T valuation.

Become a shareholder, investor and partner in Wispr Flow early in the companies story after personally reaching out to the companies founders. This year the company closed a large investment round at a $2B valuation, led by Menlo Ventures, with Goodwater Capital, Forerunner, and Acrew Capital joining as major investors, alongside an incredible group of other funds, angels, and a few celebrities.
Invested $1m. Company sold for $20 Billion.
The company’s lead Investor. Investing $2m± early into the companies growth.

MetaStat is a performance marketing partner that turns creators into entrepreneurs through data-led creative and paid media. We combine strategy, AI-enhanced content, and real-time analytics to build campaigns that drive customer acquisition and long-term brand value. To date, we’ve generated over $100M in revenue for global creator partners by helping them transform audiences into scalable businesses. By treating paid media as a growth engine, we deliver predictable, sustainable growth for founder and creator-led brands and events.

education.description: As an Investor, Board Member at Huel from 2022 to 2025, I'm honoured to have supported the company’s incredible growth up to £214M in revenue. My involvement with the company ended in late 2023 early 2024 when I joined Zoe and I stepped down from the board in late 2024 ahead of my move to America in 2025. Huel was aquired by Danone for €1bn.

In 2021, Steven Bartlett signed a new contract with The Social Chain AG to support the company in the lead up to it's stock market uplisting. Social Chain AG officially uplisted its shares to the Prime Standard segment of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange on November 12, 2021. At the time of this 2021 listing, the company's valuation had reached approximately $600 million.

ATAI is one of the world’s largest and most exciting mental health company using psychedelic and non-psychedelic drugs to heal mental health disorders so that everyone, everyone can lead a more fulfilled life. I invested in ATAI’s series C round and then joined the team as a director through their IPO. 

I worked alongside ATAI’s founder and CEO to prepare the company for its IPO. Working across everything from strategy, marketing, comms, hiring and preparing the key assets for the NASDAQ IPO. 

In 2021 ATAI IPO’d on the Nasdaq with a $3bn~ market cap. My contract was 6 months long, but I voluntarily extended for another 6 months because the IPO was delayed. I departed the company after the IPO.

Eli Lilly would later acquired AtaiBeckley for $2.8B.

In 2014 aged 21 Steven founded Social Chain & Media Chain, which went on to become “Social Chain AG” a publicly listed company with more than 500 employees, via merger. Between 2018-2020 Steven led the 'Social Chain AG' as co-CEO’s alongside Wanja Oberhof, before resigning in August 2020 at 27 years old, 6 years after founding the company. At the time of Steven's resignation Social Chain AG's market cap had reached $300m±. Steven Bartlett sold a significant portion of his shares in Social Chain AG in December 2020, when the company’s market capitalisation was approximately $300 million. The transaction, which marked Steven Bartlett’s first business exit, was facilitated by co-founder and CEO Wanja Oberhof. At the time of the sale, Bartlett was 28 years old.

After the founder of Bebo sold the company for $800m and then bought it back for $1m, I worked alongside his team in San Fransisco to bring Bebo back! 

At roughly 19-21 years old I worked across a variety of different teams in the Monkey inferno HQ in San Fransisco, building applications and driving growth.

posts.caption:
I am so glad you found me! Thought it was time I re-introduced myself. 

Hi, I’m Vanessa! Welcome to my corner of the internet! 

I’m a recovering awkward person, bestselling author, lover of behavior research, mom of two, ambivert, social overthinker. I’m here to be aggressively helpful to you.

So lovely to meet you ❤️

#gettoknowme #introduction #reintroduction #contentcreator #factsaboutme

We all want 3 things: to be understood, chosen and loved ❤️

Conversation expert @vvanedwards says great conversations are one of the fastest ways to get there.

Whether it’s with your boss, your partner or someone you’ve just met, deeper conversations can help you skip the small talk and feel genuinely understood.

What’s the best conversation you’ve had recently?

Comment ‘more’ and we’ll DM you this conversation.
Never Ever Say “Nice To Meet You” | @jenniferhudsonshow

Loved this quote by @jennifer.garner on @aspirewithemmagrede 

I know I’ve found the smallest of kind gestures to make the biggest impact.

A thoughtful text. Holding the door. Checking in on someone. Letting someone merge in traffic. Complimenting a stranger. Remembering the little thing someone mentioned weeks ago.

You never really know what someone is carrying, and a tiny gesture that takes you five seconds might be the thing that makes their entire day a little lighter.

Be the reason someone leaves an interaction feeling a little more loved than they did before. 🤍

What’s a small act of

Quick question: what do you think successful people do that the rest of us don’t?

The usual guesses are grit, a 5 a.m. alarm, or some genius-level IQ.

What I saw up close was a lot smaller than that, and a lot easier to copy. Three of the patterns are about how they think. Two are about how they treat people, especially the people who can’t do anything for them.

And every one is small enough to try in your very next conversation.

I’ll share the research behind each one. (Including the one that didn’t hold up. Yes, I’ll tell you which.)
